questions.question: The selling price of 8 articles is the same as the cost price of 12 articles. The profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given :**

The cost price of 12 articles = selling price of 8 articles

**Concept used:**

Profit% = profit/C.P × 100

**Calculation :**

CP x 12 = SP x 8

⇒ {SP over CP} = {12 over 8} 

⇒ {SP over CP} = {3 over 2}

∵ Profit = SP - CP 

⇒ Profit = 3 units - 2 units = 1 unit

⇒ Profit % = Profit/CP x 100

⇒ 1/2 x 100 = 50%

**∴ The profit percentage is 50 %**

questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 9 km/h. If it takes the same time in going 35 km downstream as it takes in going 28 km upstream, then what is the speed (in km/h) of the stream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The speed of a boat in still water is 9 km/h.

Distance covered in downstream = 35 km

Distance covered in upstream = 28 km

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

Downstream speed = (v + u)

Upstream speed = (v - u)

Where, v = Speed of the boat in still water, u = Speed of the stream

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the stream be 's' km/h

According to the question,

{35over (9 + s)} = {28over (9 - s)}

⇒ 35(9 - s) = 28(9 + s)

⇒ 5(9 - s) = 4(9 + s)

⇒ 45 - 5s = 36 + 4s

⇒ 9 = 9s

⇒ s = 1 km/h

∴ The speed of the stream is 1 km/h.

**Hence, the correct answer is 1 km/h.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys goods at 20% discount. He allows 10% discount on the marked price to his customers. What is his profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper allows 10% discount on the marked price to his customers.

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = Profit/CP × 100

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Let the marked price be Rs. x

A shopkeeper buys goods at 20% discount

⇒ x - (20% of x) = x - xover5 

⇒ 4xover5 = CP

Allows 10% discount on the marked price,

⇒ x- 10% of x = x - xover10 

⇒ 9xover10** **= SP

Profit = 9xover10 - 4xover5 = xover10

Profit percentage = {xover10}over{4xover5} × 100 

⇒ xover10 × 5over4x × 100 = 25over2 = 12.5%

**∴ The profit percentage is 12.5%**

questions.question: 8 taps having the same flow of water fill a tank in 27 minutes. After 3 minutes, 2 taps went out of service. The time taken to fill the tank by the remaining taps is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

⇒ 8 taps fill a tank in 27 minutes.

**Calculation:**

In 27 minutes, 8 taps together fill one tank.

∴ In 3 minutes, 8 taps together fill = **((1)/(27)× 3) = 1/9** part of the tank.

After 3 minutes, 2 taps went out of service.

The remaining fill in the tank = (1 - 1/9) = 8/9 part of the tank.

The remaining taps = 6

⇒ 8 taps fill one tank in 27 minutes.

∴ 6 taps fill in the 8/9 part of the tank = (8)/(9)× (27)/(6)× 8 = 32 minutes

**∴ The time taken to fill the tank with the remaining taps is 32 minutes **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

⇒ 8 taps fill a tank in 27 minutes.

**Formal used:**

 (M1 × D1 × H1)/(W1) = (M2 × D2 × H2)/(W2) 

M₁, M₂ ⇒ Total no of taps

D₁, D₂ ⇒ Days

H₁, H₂ ⇒ Hours

W₁, W₂ ⇒ Wages

**Calculation:**

⇒ (8 × 27)/(1) = (6 × H2)/(8/9) 

 H2 = (8 × 27times 8)/(6 times 9) 

H₂ = 32

∴ The time taken to fill the tank by the remaining taps is 32 minutes.

questions.question: Twenty seven years ago, at the time of marriage, the average age of a couple was 25 years. Now they have a daughter of age 25 years. What is the average age of the family?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average age of the couple 27 years ago = 25 years

The daughter's present age is 25 years

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of all terms/number of terms

**Concept:**

If operations(+, -, ×, ÷ ) are performed on all the terms of an average then it also affects the average.

for eg:

Let A be the average of a and b

If after adding n in both the terms it becomes a + n and b + n

Then, the New average will be A + n

**Calculation: **

Let the present age of wife and husband be x and y

Average** **27 years back,

Age of the wife 27 years ago = x - 27

Age of the husband 27 years ago = y - 27

Average 27 years ago = 25 

⇒ (x - 27 + y - 27)/2 = 25

⇒ x + y = 104

∴ Sum of the present ages of couple = 50 + 54 = 104

Average age of family = (104 + 25)/3 = 43

∴ The average age of the family is** 43 **years.

questions.question: A man covers a certain distance at a uniform speed in 5 hours. If he increases his speed by 1 km/h, then he takes 10 minutes less. What is the speed (in km/h) of the man?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man covers a certain distance at a uniform speed in 5 hours.

He increases his speed by 1 km/h, then he takes 10 minutes less.

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question, 

When speed increases by 1 km/h, the time is reduced to 10 minutes,

⇒ 5 h - 10 min = 4 h 50 min

⇒ Distance travelled = (speed + 1) × 4 h 50 min

∵ Distance is the same for both conditions.

⇒ Speed × 5 = (Speed + 1) × 4 h 50 min

⇒ Speed × 5 = (Speed + 1) × (4 + 50/60) hr

⇒ Speed × 5 = (Speed + 1) × 29/6

⇒ 30 × Speed = 29 × Speed + 29

⇒ (30 - 29) Speed = 29

⇒ Speed = 29 km/h

**∴ The speed of the man is 29 km/h.**

questions.question: A, B, and C working together can complete a work in 16 days. If A and B work together, they can complete the same work in 18 days. If B and C work together they can complete the same work in 24 days. In how many days can A and C complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(A, B and C) complete a work in 16 days

(A and B) complete in 18 days

(B and C) complete in 24 days

**Concept:** 

Efficiency is work done by someone in a unit of time.

**Formula used:**

Total work = Time × efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let total work be LCM of (16, 18, 24) = 144 unit

⇒ Efficiency of (A, B, C) = 144/16 = 9

⇒ Efficiency of (A and B) = 144/18 = 8

⇒ Efficiency of (B and C) = 144/24 = 6

Now, Efficiency of (A) = Efficiency of (A, B, C) - Efficiency of (B, C) = 9 - 6 = 3

Also, Efficiency of (C) = Efficiency of (A, B, C) - Efficiency of (A, B) = 9 - 8 = 1

⇒ Efficiency of (A, C) = 3 + 1 = 4

So, the time taken by A and C to complete the work = 144/4 = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36 days.**

questions.question: A gardener wants to plant trees in a garden. If the number of trees in each row is the same, and there are 105 or 210 or 315 or 525 rows, and after that, no trees left, then the least number of trees that were planted is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number of trees in each row is the same.

There are 105 or 210 or 315 or 525 rows.

**Calculation:**

The number of trees in each row for 105 or 210 or 315 or 525 rows = LCM of (105 or 210 or 315 or 525)

⇒ The prime factorization of ( 105 or 210 or 315 or 525)

⇒ 105 = 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ 210 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ 315 = 3 × 3 × 5 × 7

⇒ 525 = 3× 5× 5 × 7

LCM of (105 or 210 or 315 or 525) = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 5 × 7

**∴ The least number of trees that were planted is 3150**

questions.question: Gagan borrowed a sum of Rs. 2,500 at 8% per annum compound interest. He paid Rs. 1,000 at the end of the first year and Rs. 500 at the end of the second year. In order to clear his dues at the end of 4 years, how much (to a nearest rupee) will be have to pay?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Gagan borrowed a sum of Rs. 2,500 at 8% per annum compound interest.

Gagan paid Rs. 1,000 at the end of the first year.

Gagan paid Rs. 500 at the end of the second year.

**Formula used:**

The formula for compound interest is

A = P(1 + rover100)ⁿ 

**Calculation:**

Compound interest amount of the first year

⇒ 2,500(1 + 8over100)¹ = 2,500 × 108over100

⇒ Rs. 2,700

He paid Rs. 1,000

⇒ 2,700 - 1,000 = Rs. 1,700

Compound interest amount of the Second year

⇒ 1,700(1 + 8over100)¹ = 1,700 × 108over100 = Rs. 1,836

In the second year he paid Rs. 500

⇒ 1,836 - 5,00 = Rs. 1,336

Compound interest amount of the last Second year

⇒ 1,336(1 + 8over100)² = 1,336 × 108over100 × 108over100

⇒ 15583104over10000 = Rs. 1,558.3104

**∴ Gagan will have to pay is Rs.1558.**

If a number divided by some numbers and leave the same remainder then such least number = LCM of the numbers + remainder

**Calculation :**

The the required number = 630 + 4 = 634

**∴ The required least number is 634**
